question:
What is the output of the following C code?
`int i = 1, j = 0;`
`switch(i) {`
`  case 1: j++;`
`  case 2: j += 2; break;`
`  case 3: j += 3;`
`}`
`printf("%d", j);`
explanation: Because there is no `break` in `case 1`, fall-through occurs. `j` becomes 1 (case 1), then 1+2=3 (case 2). The `break` in case 2 stops further fall-through.
